familyLine: Six small apps from Longline Labs, built to work alike.

apps.name: Coifish
apps.description: Certificates of insurance for every vendor at every association, current and on file.

apps.name: ReelMinder
apps.description: Reminders for every association deadline, from insurance renewals to annual meeting notices.

apps.name: PacketSkipper
apps.description: Board packets, minutes, action items, all in one place.

apps.name: BallastBook
apps.description: Builds next year's budget for each association. Type the numbers beside last year's, and BallastBook works out what each unit pays and makes the PDF for the board.

apps.name: ShipShape
apps.description: Names your files the way your company names them. Drop in a PDF, answer two or three questions, and download it with the right name.

apps.name: AboveBoard
apps.description: A public page for each association's documents. Upload the bylaws, budgets, and minutes once, and owners, buyers, and lenders find them at one address.
